content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect carbonyl stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use IR spectra tool (cheaper than carbon NMR?). Both are cheap but we should minimize. Probably IR is simplest: carbonyl shows strong peak around 1700 cm-1. Could count number of distinct carbonyl peaks. Use ir_spectra tool.
